final_answer_text:
## Available Vehicle Presets

| ID | Name | Plant | Validation Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vehicle-a-otter` | Otter differential-thrust USV | planar3 | validated |
| `vehicle-b-rudder` | USV propeller/rudder monohull | **coupled6** | model-structure-trajectory-scored-fail |
| `vehicle-c-azimuth` | Dual-azimuth overactuated USV | **coupled6** | allocation-demonstrated-dynamics-unvalidated |
| `searobotics-surveyor-m1.8` | SeaRobotics SR-Surveyor M1.8 (two-body common-task approx.) | planar3 | model-structure-only |

### Presets using the `coupled6` plant:
1. **`vehicle-b-rudder`** — USV propeller/rudder monohull. Note: its MMG-based literature-coefficient parameterization has been scored against six MARIN KVLCC2 trajectories and **fails** the precommitted tolerances at USV scale — treat with caution.
2. **`vehicle-c-azimuth`** — Dual-azimuth overactuated USV. Control allocation is demonstrated, but the underlying behavioral dynamics are **not independently validated**.

Both `coupled6` vehicles currently lack validated dynamics — worth keeping in mind if you plan to use them for anything beyond exploratory or allocation-focused work.
